subject: CVehicle -- complete field layout from VALIDATE_OFFSET + Capstone sweep
_note: Complete CVehicle own-range layout (0x138..0x59F, 1128 bytes). 86 fields from VALIDATE_OFFSET (disassembly/game_sa/CVehicle.h) cross-verified by Capstone sweep of 14 anchor functions. Bitfield unions documented: m_nHandlingFlagsIntValue@0x38C (29 handling flags), m_nVehicleFlags@0x4EC (52 vehicle behaviour flags, 8 bytes), m_nBombState@0x4A8 (bomb/lights/winch packed bits), m_nRenderLightsFlags@0x584 (4 light bits). Offsets absolute from object base. field_4EC / field_4ED renamed to m_nVehicleFlags (the vehicle bitflag block identified by cross-reference of disassembly source declaration vs VALIDATE_OFFSET evidence). Structural padding bytes NOT listed as fields: 0x4A5(1B), 0x4AF(1B), 0x4B5-7(3B), 0x509-B(3B), 0x585-7(3B) = 11 bytes total.
provenance: cold disassembly of gta_sa.exe (1.0 US); names from disassembly CVehicle.h VALIDATE_OFFSET macros; flags from CVehicle.h class body declarations

fields.name: m_nHandlingFlagsIntValue

bitfields.name: bUseMaxspLimit

fields.name: m_autoPilot

fields.name: m_nCreationTime

fields.name: m_nPrimaryColor

fields.name: m_nGettingOutFlags

fields.name: m_nNitroBoosts

fields.name: m_nSpecialColModel
fields.note: Special collision model index (see CVehicle::m_aSpecialColModel).

fields.name: m_pEntityWeAreOn

fields.name: m_pFire

fields.name: m_fSteerAngle
fields.note: Current front-wheel steer angle (radians).

fields.name: m_f2ndSteerAngle
fields.note: Secondary steer angle (rear wheels, elevator, rudder, etc.).

fields.name: m_fGasPedal
fields.note: Gas pedal input: 0.0 = off, 1.0 = full throttle.

fields.name: m_fBreakPedal
fields.note: Brake pedal input: 0.0 = off, 1.0 = full brake.

fields.name: m_nCreatedBy
fields.note: See eVehicleCreatedBy: RANDOM(1), MISSION(2), PARKED(3), PERMANENT(4).

fields.name: m_nExtendedRemovalRange
fields.note: Override removal distance (game uses min(this, 170.0)). 0 = default.

fields.name: m_nBombState
fields.note: Packed bitfields: m_nBombOnBoard(bits 0-2, see eBombState), m_nOverrideLights(bits 3-4), m_nWinchType(bits 5-6), m_nGunsCycleIndex(bits 8-9), m_nOrdnanceCycleIndex(bits 10-11). Byte[0]=0x4A8, Byte[1]=0x4A9.

fields.name: m_nUsedForCover
fields.note: Number of cops currently using this vehicle as cover.

fields.name: m_nAmmoInClip
fields.note: Ammo in clip for vehicle-mounted boat gun (reload at 20).

fields.name: m_nPacMansCollected
fields.note: Pac-Man pickups collected (initialised, not used in SA).

fields.name: m_nPedsPositionForRoadBlock
fields.note: Roadblock ped position slot: 0, 1, or 2.

fields.name: m_nNumCopsForRoadBlock
fields.note: Number of cops to spawn for this roadblock vehicle.

fields.name: m_fDirtLevel
fields.note: Dirt accumulation on bodywork: 0.0 = clean, 15.0 = max visible dirt.

fields.name: m_nCurrentGear
fields.note: Current transmission gear (0=reverse, 1=neutral, 2+= gears).

fields.name: m_fGearChangeCount
fields.note: Gear-change parameter passed to CTransmission::CalculateDriveAcceleration (static in SA).

fields.name: m_fWheelSpinForAudio
fields.note: Wheel spin rate fed to audio engine for tyre screech sounds.

fields.name: m_fHealth
fields.note: Vehicle health: 1000.0 = full. Drops to 0 = explosion. Set by CVehicle::Fix.

fields.name: m_pTractor
fields.note: Pointer to tractor vehicle towing this one. NULL if not being towed.

fields.name: m_pTrailer
fields.note: Pointer to trailer vehicle being towed. NULL if not towing.

fields.name: m_pWhoInstalledBombOnMe
fields.note: Pointer to the ped who planted the bomb on this vehicle.

fields.name: m_nTimeTillWeNeedThisCar
fields.note: Game won't auto-delete this vehicle until timer expires.

fields.name: m_nGunFiringTime
fields.note: Last game time (ms) when vehicle gun was fired (boats).

fields.name: m_nTimeWhenBlowedUp
fields.note: Game time when vehicle was blown up; deleted 60s after this.

fields.name: m_nCopsInCarTimer
fields.note: Timer for police car occupants to stay in pursuit vehicle. Increments when player stops.

fields.name: m_wBombTimer
fields.note: Timed-bomb countdown (decrements each frame).

fields.name: m_pWhoDetonatedMe
fields.note: Ped who detonated this vehicle (copied from m_pWhoInstalledBombOnMe at detonation).

fields.name: m_fVehicleFrontGroundZ
fields.note: Z height of ground under front axle (from collision query).

fields.name: m_fVehicleRearGroundZ
fields.note: Z height of ground under rear axle (from collision query).

fields.name: m_nVehicleFlags
fields.note: Packed vehicle behaviour bitflags (52 flags across 8 bytes). Byte 0 (0x4EC): bIsLawEnforcer|bIsAmbulanceOnDuty|bIsFireTruckOnDuty|bIsLocked|bEngineOn|bIsHandbrakeOn|bLightsOn|bFreebies. Byte 1 (0x4ED): bIsVan|bIsBus|bIsBig|bLowVehicle|bComedyControls|bWarnedPeds|bCraneMessageDone|bTakeLessDamage. Byte 2 (0x4EE): bIsDamaged|bHasBeenOwnedByPlayer|bFadeOut|bIsBeingCarJacked|bCreateRoadBlockPeds|bCanBeDamaged|bOccupantsHaveBeenGenerated|bGunSwitchedOff. Byte 3 (0x4EF): bVehicleColProcessed|bIsCarParkVehicle|bHasAlreadyBeenRecorded|bPartOfConvoy|bHeliMinimumTilt|bAudioChangingGear|bIsDrowning|bTyresDontBurst. Byte 4 (0x4F0): bCreatedAsPoliceVehicle|bRestingOnPhysical|bParking|bCanPark|bFireGun|bDriverLastFrame|bNeverUseSmallerRemovalRange|bIsRCVehicle. Byte 5 (0x4F1): bAlwaysSkidMarks|bEngineBroken|bVehicleCanBeTargetted|bPartOfAttackWave|bWinchCanPickMeUp|bImpounded|bVehicleCanBeTargettedByHS|bSirenOrAlarm. Byte 6 (0x4F2): bHasGangLeaningOn|bGangMembersForRoadBlock|bDoesProvideCover|bMadDriver|bUpgradedStereo|bConsideredByPlayer|bPetrolTankIsWeakPoint|bDisableParticles. Byte 7 (0x4F3): bHasBeenResprayed|bUseCarCheats|bDontSetColourWhenRemapping|bUsedForReplay|pad4..pad7.

bitfields.name: bIsFireTruckOnDuty

bitfields.name: bHasBeenOwnedByPlayer

bitfields.name: bFadeOut
bitfields.desc: Vehicle is fading out before removal

bitfields.name: bCanBeDamaged
bitfields.desc: Vehicle can take damage (false during cut scenes)

bitfields.name: bGunSwitchedOff
bitfields.desc: Vehicle guns disabled (level designer flag for boats)

bitfields.name: bIsDrowning
bitfields.desc: Vehicle is submerged; occupants taking drowning damage

bitfields.name: bCreatedAsPoliceVehicle

bitfields.name: bRestingOnPhysical
bitfields.desc: Sitting on a physical object (prevents going static)

bitfields.name: bCanPark
bitfields.desc: Vehicle can be parked by AI

bitfields.name: bFireGun
bitfields.desc: AI wants to fire vehicle weapon this frame

bitfields.name: bNeverUseSmallerRemovalRange

bitfields.name: bAlwaysSkidMarks
bitfields.desc: Always leave skid marks regardless of wheel state

bitfields.name: bEngineBroken
bitfields.desc: Engine is dead (player can get in but cannot drive)

bitfields.name: bVehicleCanBeTargetted
bitfields.desc: Driver can be lock-on targeted (Toreno mission flag)

bitfields.name: bWinchCanPickMeUp
bitfields.desc: Can be picked up by crane/magnet winch

bitfields.name: bImpounded
bitfields.desc: Has been through police impound garage

bitfields.name: bVehicleCanBeTargettedByHS
bitfields.desc: Heat-seeking missiles can target this vehicle

bitfields.name: bSirenOrAlarm
bitfields.desc: Siren or alarm is currently active

bitfields.name: bHasGangLeaningOn
bitfields.desc: Gang member is leaning on this vehicle

bitfields.name: bGangMembersForRoadBlock
bitfields.desc: Spawns gang members for roadblock (if NumPedsForRoadBlock > 0)

bitfields.name: bDoesProvideCover
bitfields.desc: Can be used as cover by AI peds

bitfields.name: bUpgradedStereo
bitfields.desc: Vehicle has an upgraded stereo system

bitfields.name: bConsideredByPlayer
bitfields.desc: Player is considering entering this vehicle

bitfields.name: bPetrolTankIsWeakPoint
bitfields.desc: Shooting petrol tank causes explosion (if false, it doesn't)

bitfields.name: bHasBeenResprayed
bitfields.desc: Resprayed since last respray-check (resets after check)

bitfields.name: bDontSetColourWhenRemapping
bitfields.desc: Don't change colour when texture is remapped

bitfields.name: bUsedForReplay
bitfields.desc: Controlled by replay system; remove when replay ends

fields.name: field_4F4
fields.note: 4 bytes between vehicle flags and m_eDoorLock. Purpose unknown; possibly padding or unused.

fields.name: m_eDoorLock
fields.note: Door lock state. See eDoorLock enum: UNLOCKED, LOCKED, LOCKOUT_PLAYER_ONLY, etc.

fields.name: m_nProjectileWeaponFiringTime
fields.note: Last fire time for manual-aimed projectiles (Hunter/Hydra).

fields.name: m_nAdditionalProjectileWeaponFiringTime
fields.note: Last fire time for additional projectile weapon (Hydra manual-aimed).

fields.name: m_nTimeForMinigunFiring
fields.note: Minigun firing time (Hunter minigun).

fields.name: m_nLastWeaponDamageType
fields.note: Last eWeaponType that damaged this vehicle. -1 (0xFF) if no damage.

fields.name: m_pLastDamageEntity
fields.note: Last entity that damaged this vehicle.

fields.name: field_510
fields.note: Unknown 1B field. Initialised to 0 in constructor.

fields.name: field_511
fields.note: Unknown 1B field. Initialised but unused.

fields.name: field_512
fields.note: Unknown 1B field. Initialised but unused.

fields.name: m_nVehicleWeaponInUse
fields.note: Current vehicle weapon slot. See eCarWeapon enum.

fields.name: m_nHornCounter
fields.note: Horn activation counter (decrements each frame).

fields.name: m_HornPattern
fields.note: Horn honk pattern ID.

fields.name: m_nCarHornTimer
fields.note: Horn timer for car horn sequences.

fields.name: m_comedyControlState
fields.note: Comedy-control steering state: INACTIVE, STEER_RIGHT, STEER_LEFT.

fields.name: m_nHasslePosId
fields.note: Hassle position ID used in gang-hassle scenarios.

fields.name: m_FrontCollPoly
fields.note: Stored collision polygon under the front of the vehicle (for wheel contact queries).

fields.name: m_RearCollPoly
fields.note: Stored collision polygon under the rear of the vehicle (for wheel contact queries).

fields.name: m_anCollisionLighting
fields.note: Per-corner collision lighting: [left-front, left-rear, right-front, right-rear].

fields.name: m_pOverheatParticle
fields.note: FxSystem for engine overheat steam. NULL if not playing.

fields.name: m_pFireParticle
fields.note: FxSystem for vehicle fire. NULL if not playing.

fields.name: m_pDustParticle
fields.note: FxSystem for road dust. NULL if not playing.

fields.name: m_nRenderLightsFlags

fields.name: m_pCustomCarPlate
fields.note: Custom number-plate RwTexture (CCustomCarPlateMgr). NULL = default plate.

fields.name: m_fRawSteerAngle
fields.note: Raw input steer angle before suspension/geometry scaling. Also called fSteer.

fields.name: m_nVehicleClass
fields.note: Vehicle base class/type (car, bike, boat, plane, heli, etc.).

fields.name: m_nVehicleSubClass
fields.note: Vehicle sub-class (e.g. quad vs bike within bike class).

fields.name: m_nPreviousRemapTxd
fields.note: Previous remap TXD index (before last SetRemapTexDictionary call).

fields.name: m_nRemapTxd
fields.note: Active remap TXD index. -1 = using default texture dictionary.

fields.name: m_pRemapTexture
fields.note: Active remap RwTexture pointer. NULL = not remapped.
